lines.text: Syphon Shards to unlock and level up your Attributes!
lines.gloss: Syphon 是将碎片吸收到永久属性中的操作。
lines.zh: 吸收碎片以解锁并升级你的属性!

segments.text: Syphon Shards to unlock and level up your
segments.zh: 吸收碎片以解锁并升级你的

lines.text: Each Attribute grant its own unique power, active at all times, no matter where you are.
lines.gloss: 服务器原文 grant 的语法错误照录。
lines.zh: 每种属性都会提供独特效果，无论身处何处均持续生效。

, active at all times, no matter where you are.

lines.text: Attributes can reach up to level 10, with shard costs scaling based on their rarity.
lines.gloss: 最高等级与稀有度消耗核对 Attributes 页面。
lines.zh: 属性最高可升至 10 级，升级所需碎片数量随稀有度提高。

segments.text: , with shard costs scaling based on their
segments.zh: 级，升级所需碎片数量随

lines.text: Search for specific attributes in your Attribute Menu. You can enter the Attribute Name, ID, Family, or Attribute Category!
lines.zh: 在属性菜单中搜索指定属性。可输入属性名称、ID、族类或属性类别!

lines.text: Do you still have old items, with greyed out Attributes on them?
lines.zh: 你还有带灰显属性的旧物品吗?

lines.text: You can use this Anvil to transfer those Attributes to the new system!
lines.zh: 你可以使用此铁砧，将这些属性转移到新系统中!

lines.text: Advanced Mode lets you see every attribute, and find out how to obtain them.
lines.zh: 高级模式可查看所有属性及其获取方式。

lines.text: Advanced Mode unlocked at 30 unique Attributes.
lines.zh: 拥有 30 种不同属性后解锁高级模式。
